chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Give to the one who asks, even if you are on horseback."

key_terms.أَعْطِ: Give; an imperative command to offer assistance or charity.
key_terms.السَّائِلَ: The one who asks; the beggar or petitioner seeking help.
key_terms.ظَهْرِ: Back; here referring to being mounted.
key_terms.فَرَسٍ: Horse; indicating even while riding and not settled.

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam عليه السلام teach about giving charity to one who asks?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches readiness and promptness in charity toward one who asks. It emphasizes generosity and responsiveness, even when a person is occupied or in motion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Give to the one who asks, even if you are on horseback."
